name: Web Development Fundamentals
subject: web-dev
description: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, DOM APIs and browser fundamentals

questions.question: Which HTML tag is used to create a hyperlink?
questions.explanation: The (anchor) tag creates hyperlinks. The destination URL goes in the href attribute: text

questions.question: Which CSS property controls the text colour?
questions.explanation: The CSS 'color' property sets the text colour. Example: color: #ff0000;

questions.question: What does the 'typeof' operator return for an array in JavaScript?
questions.explanation: In JavaScript, typeof [] returns 'object'. Use Array.isArray() to check specifically for arrays.

questions.question: What is the correct way to select an element with id 'header' in CSS?
questions.explanation: IDs are selected with '#' in CSS. Class selectors use '.'. So #header targets <div id='header'>.

questions.question: Which method adds an element to the end of a JavaScript array?
questions.explanation: array.push(item) adds one or more elements to the end of an array and returns the new length.
